svg.title: AREA 08
svg.desc: One crosses six fences; teammates hold pads 1→6, changing only after the crossing call. The pink switch requires four shields. Clear the crescent-room traps, press the center switch, then destroy each red or blue flame. One crosses the fences; teammates hold pads 1→6. Call after each crossing; do not release early. Facing in from the entrance: left column far→near is 3, 6, 4; right is 5, 2, 1. After fence 6, press green to open the left path for the others. Drop 4 shields to open the gate; armor does not count. Clear traps, then press the center pad. Shoot each blue/red flame as it reappears until the door opens.
